scope: the entity count is read as a whole byte from the same byte that carries the A/B bits, which explains the crash

disassembly.0x66ED70: byte reader: movzx eax, byte [cursor]; cursor++ - it does NOT read bits

deduction.bit_cursor_at_1307: A is at byte163 bit3, B at bit4; the bit reader does not advance the byte cursor for these two (1307&7=3, 1308&7=4)
deduction.byte_cursor_stays_163: so 0x66ED70 reads byte163 as the whole count
deduction.our_byte163: 0xF8 = 248, because bit3/bit4 were set and the count bit landed in bit5
deduction.consequence: count=248 makes the parser read 248*12 bits of ids, runs off the buffer and crashes before any field value is read
